coach.title: Coach
coach.subtitle: Ask about your own numbers.
coach.disclaimer: Replies come from a language model reading your own estimates. They are not medical advice.
coach.offBody: The coach sends your question and a summary of your numbers to Anthropic. That needs network access, which is off on this phone. You can switch it on under Privacy.
coach.keyBody: The coach uses your own Anthropic API key. It stays in this phone's secure storage and is never exported.
coach.emptyChat: Ask anything about your readiness, sleep, load, HRV or resting heart rate.
coach.error.network-off: Network access for the coach is off, so nothing was sent.
coach.error.no-key: There is no API key on this phone. Add one in Coach settings.
coach.error.invalid-key: Anthropic did not accept the API key. It may be wrong or revoked. Enter a new key in Coach settings.
coach.error.forbidden: This API key is not allowed to use this model. Check your Anthropic account or pick another model.
coach.error.billing: Anthropic reports a billing problem on your account. Check it at console.anthropic.com.
coach.error.rate-limited: Too many requests right now. Wait a minute and try again.
coach.error.overloaded: Anthropic is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
coach.error.server: Anthropic had a problem answering. Try again later.
coach.error.model-unavailable: This model is not available for your key. Pick another model in Coach settings.
coach.error.rejected: Anthropic rejected the request. Try a shorter question or start a new conversation.
coach.error.refused: The model declined to answer this question.
coach.error.incomplete: The reply was cut off. Try asking a shorter question.
coach.error.invalid-response: The reply could not be read. Nothing was stored. Try again.
coach.error.timeout: No answer within a minute. Check your connection and try again.
coach.error.network: Could not reach Anthropic. Check your connection and try again.
coach.error.storage: Could not read or save coach data on this phone.
coach.history.title: History
coach.history.body: Your conversations with the coach. They are stored only on this phone.
coach.history.deleteBody: It is removed from this phone. This cannot be undone.
coach.memory.title: Memory
coach.memory.body: Notes the coach may use, fully visible here. Only you add notes, or the coach when you ask it to remember something.
coach.memory.toggleBody: The coach remembers what you tell it. These notes go along with each question.
coach.memory.offNote: Memory is off: these notes are not sent and the coach adds none.
coach.memory.full: You have {max} notes, the maximum. Delete one first.
coach.memory.empty: No notes yet. Use Add next to a group.
coach.checkIn.title: Check-in
coach.checkIn.body: A quiet note inside the app when one of your numbers is clearly outside your usual range. Nothing is sent unless you ask the coach.
coach.checkIn.toggleBody: Off by default. Compared on this phone against your previous 30 days.
coach.checkIn.none: Nothing clearly changed on your latest day.
coach.checkIn.needsHistory: Check-ins need at least 4 earlier days with data.
coach.checkIn.question: My {metric} on {day} was {value}, while my usual is {usual}. What could explain that?
coach.settings.title: Coach settings
coach.settings.networkOn: Network for the coach is on
coach.settings.networkOff: Network for the coach is off
coach.settings.keySaved: A key is saved in this phone's secure storage.
coach.settings.keyHint: Create one at console.anthropic.com. Usage is billed to your own Anthropic account.
coach.settings.keyInvalid: This does not look like an Anthropic API key. It starts with sk-ant-.
coach.settings.removeKeyBody: The coach stops working until you add a key again. Your conversations stay.
coach.settings.modelHint: Sonnet 5.5 is the default. Opus 5.5 is slower and costs more. Haiku 5.5 is the fastest and cheapest.
coach.settings.seesBody: Each question sends exactly this text, plus the messages of the current conversation. No name, no band identifiers, no raw readings.
coach.settings.deleteAllBody: Removes all conversations, memory notes and the API key from this phone. This cannot be undone.
network.title: Network
network.globalBody: Off by default. While off, OpenHoop makes no network requests at all.
network.coach.title: Coach
network.coach.sends: Sends: your question, the current conversation and what you allow in Coach settings. By default that is the last 7 days of readiness, sleep score, load, HRV and resting heart rate, and your memory notes. Journal answers and sensor details only go along when you switch them on. When you build a strength workout with the coach: your description, your exercise list (including the names of your own exercises) and up to 30 recent working weights with their dates.
network.coach.to: To: Anthropic (api.anthropic.com), with your own API key. Nothing is sent until you ask a question or describe a workout.
coach.settings.enabledOn: Uses your own API key. Nothing leaves the phone until network access for the coach is on as well.
coach.settings.enabledOff: Off. The chat and check-ins stay closed and nothing is sent.
coach.settings.onDeviceBody: Not available: no language model runs well enough on a phone yet.
coach.settings.ownKeyBody: Anthropic, billed to you. Only the data you allow below is sent.
coach.settings.proactivity.offBody: The coach only answers when you ask. No check-ins.
coach.settings.proactivity.weeklyBody: A review of last week from Monday on, plus a check-in when a number is clearly outside your usual range. Worked out on this phone.
coach.settings.proactivity.patternsBody: A check-in only when a number is clearly outside your usual range. Worked out on this phone.
coach.settings.access.scoresBody: Readiness, sleep score, load, HRV and resting heart rate of the last 7 days.
coach.settings.access.journalBody: Your journal answers of the last 7 days.
coach.settings.access.sensorsBody: Daily breathing rate, blood oxygen, skin temperature, heart rate, steps and sleep time. Never raw samples.
coach.coachOffBody: Switch it on in Coach settings. Nothing is sent while it is off.
coach.micListening: Listening… transcribed on this phone. Tap the mic again to stop.
coach.checkIn.weekQuestion: My average {metric} last week was {value}, against {usual} the week before. Can you review my week?
coach.checkIn.replyAsk.sick: I think I'm getting sick. What should I keep in mind today?
coach.checkIn.replyAsk.tired: I'm just tired. Is there anything I should change today?
coach.checkIn.replyAsk.travelling: I'm travelling. How should I read these numbers?
coach.history.deleteHint: Tap the bin to delete one.
coach.memory.editHint: Opens the note to edit it or move it to another group.
coach.checkIn.bannerDown: {metric} is lower than usual. How are you feeling?
coach.checkIn.bannerUp: {metric} is higher than usual. How are you feeling?
coach.checkIn.bannerStreakDown: {metric} has been lower than usual for {count} days. How are you feeling?
coach.checkIn.bannerStreakUp: {metric} has been higher than usual for {count} days. How are you feeling?
coach.checkIn.bannerWeek: Your review of last week is ready.
coach.checkIn.messageStreak: It has been outside your usual range for {count} days in a row.
coach.checkIn.messageSkin: Skin temperature is {value} against your baseline.
coach.checkIn.weekMessage: Last week your average {metric} was {value}, against {usual} the week before. Want to go over it with the coach?
coach.checkIn.footPatterns: They appear only when a number is clearly outside your usual range, compared on this phone. Change this in Coach settings.
coach.checkIn.footWeekly: A review of last week appears from Monday, plus a check-in when a number is clearly outside your usual range. Change this in Coach settings.
coach.checkIn.coachOff: The coach is switched off in Coach settings, so there are no check-ins.
coach.checkIn.questionPrivateDown: My {metric} looks lower than usual. What could explain that?
coach.checkIn.questionPrivateUp: My {metric} looks higher than usual. What could explain that?
coach.checkIn.weekQuestionPrivateDown: Can you review my last week? My {metric} looked lower than the week before.
coach.checkIn.weekQuestionPrivateUp: Can you review my last week? My {metric} looked higher than the week before.
coach.settings.seesOff: The coach is switched off, so nothing is sent. This is what a question would send once you switch it on.
